summary: Iter30 verified Control Center reconciliation, human labels, workspace type filter, and Draft→Preview→Publish entitlements end-to-end. Backend: 17/17 pytest passed (test_iter30_control_reconciliation.py). Reconciliation across pages holds: overview.accounts={total:2,individual:2,company:0,enterprise:0}, plan_distribution={trial:2} (no 'free' key), subscriptions.summary={trialing:2,active:0}, /customers returns exactly 2 rows (Loiy owner, Mohammed owner) with role_label='Owner' (no WORKSPACE_OWNER enum, no 'free', no ariadni.ai/teamtest/admin@ariadni.id leaks), /workspaces returns 2 (both individual); type=company → 0, type=individual → 2; include_internal=true bumps both /customers and /workspaces beyond the defaults and reveals 'TapPresence HQ'. Entitlements: plans exactly ['trial','pro','team','enterprise'] (no 'free', no 'white_label'); provider_status = {wallet:false, ai_followup:true, custom_domain:false, api:true}; PUT rejects 'free' and 'white_label' with 400; preview returns diff+affected_customers; publish writes to commercial_config.entitlement_overrides and creates 'admin.entitlements.publish' audit entry (verified via /admin/control/audit). Authorization: work@gmail.com gets 403 on all 5 /admin/control/* endpoints tested and is redirected from /control/customers to /dashboard. Frontend Playwright (1920×1080): admin lands on /control; /control/customers shows 2 compact tap-to-open cards with 'Owner' label and 'Trial' plan, detail dialog opens with human labels; include-internal toggle bumps to 3 rows; /control/companies titled 'Workspaces' with ws-type-all/company/individual chips (company→0 rows, individual→2 rows, no 'TapPresence HQ' in default); /control/product shows 4 plan tabs (no ent-plan-free / no ent-plan-white_label), human labels present (Max cards, Mobile wallet passes, AI follow-up, Card scanner, Remove branding, Custom domain, API access), ent-unavailable-wallet + ent-unavailable-custom_domain badges rendered while ent-unavailable-ai_followup is absent (EMERGENT_LLM_KEY configured); Draft→Preview dialog opens, reason field accepts input, Confirm & Publish shows 'Entitlements published & audited' toast. Regression: normal customer login → /dashboard succeeds and cannot reach /control/*.
critical_code_review_comments: customer_ws_filter/is_real_paid/display_plan helpers are correctly shared across /overview, /customers, /workspaces, /subscriptions — reconciliation math holds by construction.

PUT /admin/control/entitlements does not reject empty overrides on the backend (frontend disables confirm button via `disabled={!preview || !Object.keys(preview.diff).length}`); consider server-side 400 if diff is empty to fully prevent audit-log noise.
ROLE_LABELS map correctly translates WORKSPACE_OWNER→Owner; ENT_LABEL covers all shipped keys; white_label key is filtered out at UI layer (never sent to editor).
ENTITLEMENT_PROVIDER wallet requires BOTH Apple+Google keys via any(); currently correctly returns false when neither is configured.
